chapterRuleHints: إِعْمَالُ الصِّفَةِ الْمُشَبَّهَةِ بِاسْمِ الْفَاعِلِ
How Adjectives Describe a Noun’s Feature
unit.explanation: The first noun (الْوَرْدَةُ) names the flower. The adjective (جَمِيلٌ) is the predicate (khabar): it helps tell us about the flower. The following noun (لَوْنُهَا) names the particular thing that is beautiful. Grammarians call it the grammatical subject (fāʿil) of the adjective (جَمِيلٌ). Here “subject” does not mean that a colour is doing an action.
